verdict.rationale: Render documents fully managed databases (Render Postgres with point-in-time recovery, read replicas and high availability) and psql access through its CLI. Nothing in the evidence describes a serverless SQL database or an HTTP/serverless driver that lets code query without managing connections. Managed Postgres and CLI psql sessions are adjacent features, not the capability this story names.

support.subject: As a developer, I can query a serverless SQL database directly from my code with no connection management
